observation_summary: A NullPointerException occurs during argument matching when one of the arguments is null.
reasoning_summary: The code in 'ArgumentMatchingTool.toStringEquals' attempted to call the 'toString()' method on an argument object without checking if the object was null. When a null argument was passed to the method, it triggered a NullPointerException. The fix introduces a conditional check to handle null arguments by returning the string 'null' instead of attempting to invoke a method on a null reference.
